name: Ravindra Energy Limited
summary: Ravindra Energy Limited sells solar pumps and setting up of solar generation power plants in India. The company undertakes various projects relating to solar photo voltaic power pumping systems, rooftop solar, and ground-mount solar power projects at various locations in the state of Karnataka, Maharashtra, and Rajasthan. It also generates and sells power; and trades in sugar and coal. The company was formerly known as Ravindra Trading and Agencies Limited and changed its name to Ravindra Energy Limited. Ravindra Energy Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Belgaum, India.
